via: Metabase POST /api/dataset (native SQL, request+query wall clock; not saved card dashboard rendering)
cache_policy: ad-hoc native SQL requests; cache setting measured in preflight; cached result flags checked where exposed
caveat: Metabase response time includes API overhead. Cache-hit flags are not guaranteed in all Metabase versions.

cards.baseline_sql:
SELECT (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::date AS day,
       count(*) AS success_count, sum(t.amount) AS success_amount
FROM core.transactions t
WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS'
  AND t.created_at >= ((DATE '2026-11-13') - 89)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran'
  AND t.created_at <  ((DATE '2026-11-13') + 1)::timestamp  AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
cards.optimized_sql:
SELECT date AS day,
       sum(success_count) AS success_count,
       sum(success_amount) AS success_amount
FROM marts.agg_daily_sales
WHERE date >= addDays(toDate('2026-11-13'), -89)
  AND date <= toDate('2026-11-13')
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;

cards.baseline_sql:
SELECT (t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::date AS day, t.channel,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS')::numeric
         / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','REVERSED')), 0) AS success_rate
FROM core.transactions t
WHERE t.created_at >= ((DATE '2026-11-13') - 29)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran'
  AND t.created_at <  ((DATE '2026-11-13') + 1)::timestamp  AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
cards.optimized_sql:
SELECT date AS day,
       channel,
       toFloat64(sum(success_count)) / nullIf(toFloat64(sum(terminal_count)), 0) AS success_rate
FROM marts.agg_daily_channel
WHERE date >= addDays(toDate('2026-11-13'), -29)
  AND date <= toDate('2026-11-13')
GROUP BY day, channel
ORDER BY day, channel;

cards.baseline_sql:
SELECT m.merchant_id, m.name, sum(t.amount) AS success_amount
FROM core.transactions t JOIN core.merchants m USING (merchant_id)
WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS'
  AND t.created_at >= date_trunc('month', (DATE '2026-11-13')::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran'
  AND t.created_at <  ((DATE '2026-11-13') + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran'
GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.name
ORDER BY success_amount DESC, m.merchant_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
cards.optimized_sql:
SELECT a.merchant_id,
       m.name,
       a.success_amount
FROM
(
    SELECT merchant_id, sum(success_amount) AS success_amount
    FROM marts.agg_daily_merchant
    WHERE date >= toStartOfMonth(toDate('2026-11-13'))
      AND date <= toDate('2026-11-13')
    GROUP BY merchant_id
    ORDER BY success_amount DESC, merchant_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
) AS a
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT merchant_id, name
    FROM marts.dim_merchant_history
    WHERE is_current = 1
) AS m ON a.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
ORDER BY a.success_amount DESC, a.merchant_id ASC;

cards.baseline_sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::date AS month, m.risk_level,
       count(*) AS success_count, sum(t.amount) AS success_amount
FROM core.transactions t JOIN core.merchants m USING (merchant_id)
WHERE t.status = 'SUCCESS'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
cards.optimized_sql:
SELECT toStartOfMonth(date) AS month,
       risk_level,
       sum(success_count) AS success_count,
       sum(success_amount) AS success_amount
FROM marts.agg_daily_risk
GROUP BY month, risk_level
ORDER BY month, risk_level;
